description: Dublin City Council (Dublin City Cultural Audit) publishes an annual count of heritage sites, historic monuments and government buildings in the Dublin region, with title, description, two address lines, NACE code, latitude and longitude, DCC area, census small area and electoral division. Coverage: the Dublin region, Ireland; an annual audit published in 2024 and last modified on 2025-06-19. Format and access: CSV, WMS, GEOJSON, downloadable without registration from the Smart Dublin open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution; cost: free. Caveats: it is a cultural audit of venues, not a protected-structures register, so it is not a complete list of listed buildings; the record count was not read. Simulation uses: exposure of heritage and civic buildings in flood and fire scenarios, and small-area demand for cultural facilities. Related catalogue records: Dublin Fire Brigade stations (Dublin region) (data-dublin-fire-brigade-stations).
